name: Sec oversight

subjectOf.text: Form PF raised regulatory oversight of private funds to unprecedented levels by requiring managers to disclose, for the first time, information about themselves, their funds, their investors, performance, financing, risk metrics, strategies, and credit exposure.
subjectOf.abstract: increased the level of regulatory oversight of private funds to unprecedented levels.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Private Fund Industry Five Years after the Dodd-Frank Act – A Survey Study (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2732915
scope_conditions: registered investment managers subject to periodic Form PF reporting

subjectOf.text: The reporting obligations imposed on private fund advisers by Form PF raised regulatory oversight of private funds to unprecedented levels.
subjectOf.abstract: Reporting obligations on Form PF72 increase the regulatory oversight of pri- vate funds to unprecedented levels.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Post Dodd-Frank Act Evolution of the Private Fund Industry Comparative Evidence from 2012 and 2 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2739479
scope_conditions: after Form PF became operative in 2012
